## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The `--exclude` default should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`; CI-supplied exclusions are currently ignored, violating project policy.

## Changes
Adds repeatable filename-glob exclusions, skip logging, flag documentation, and tests. This review read the tests without running them.

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclusion default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude`, your CLI includes matching files because the default is always `[]`. This violates .agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11: “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs configuring exclusions through the environment produce archives containing files they intended to omit.
